aboutGame.title: What is Clone Builders?
paragraphs: Clone Builders is an experimental Roblox building sandbox in which NPC clones are given an idea and use a structured building system to place, resize, move and assemble parts into creations inside the world. It is made by the Roblox group Synoptic Interactive and is described by the developers as a testing ground for their larger clone-related projects.

Because the game is described as constantly changing, experiments and unusual clone behaviour appear over time, and some features may reach the developers' future games. The official description recommends a private server for large builds and minigames. It does not document units, gear, tiers, gacha, boss drops, levels, maps or codes, so this wiki states that clearly instead of inventing values.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Clone Builders.

items.question: What is Clone Builders?
items.answer: Clone Builders is an experimental Roblox building sandbox by Synoptic Interactive. You give NPC clones an idea and they use a structured building system to place, resize, move and assemble parts into creations inside the world.

items.question: Do I need to spend Robux to progress in Clone Builders?
items.answer: The official description does not document paid progression, passes or multipliers. Treat claims about required Robux spending as unverified.

items.question: What should I do first in Clone Builders?
items.answer: Start with a small idea, watch how your clones place, resize and move parts, then assemble a simple creation. The game is described as a testing ground, so expect behaviour to change over time.

items.question: Are there codes or free rewards in Clone Builders?
items.answer: No working codes are documented by the official game. The description does not include a code system, so any page claiming active Clone Builders codes is unverified.

items.question: How many clones can I control in Clone Builders?
items.answer: The official description does not document a clone cap. Check in-game limits directly, and keep experiments small enough to observe clone behaviour clearly.

items.question: Where can I find Clone Builders guides and updates?
items.answer: This Clone Builders Wiki collects beginner steps, the building system, clone behavior, build ideas, private server advice, and an update tracker in one place, based on the official Roblox page and documented facts.
